section: 7-12, 33: pure planner architecture and unit test validation
margin_empirical_validation: See capacity_uplift.json -- the margin's real-world necessity is demonstrated by the default-fails/auto-succeeds finding at ctx=28500 on real hardware, not by a separate synthetic margin-sizing experiment.
layer_order_rationale: Ascending layer index, GPU-first (fill_split() in kv_residency_policy.c): the simplest possible stable, deterministic order. Deliberately NOT derived from Phase 11's precision-sensitivity ranking (that answered a quality-under-quantization question, not a placement-capacity question) and not any other learned/heuristic ordering -- Section 9 explicitly asks for the simplest stable choice, not an invented policy.
objective_rationale: AUTO maximizes GPU-resident KV layers subject to budget (Section 8). This is a conservative-compatibility choice (closest to pre-Phase-12H behavior when budget allows), explicitly NOT a performance claim -- Phase 12G found no GPU-KV throughput advantage in its tested regime, and this phase's own performance.json shows an ambiguous, noisy result at a larger context. A CPU-first AUTO alternative is documented as a possible future policy (not built, no evidence gathered to justify it yet).
